title: Melody
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use short tunes of three or four notes. The teacher sings, the class listens, then echoes.

skills.key_step: The child says a melodic sound has a tune and sorts sounds into melodic and non-melodic.
representations: a flute or a sung tune

board.do: Hum a tune, then bang the desk.

misconceptions.ask: Does a drum make a sound with a tune you can hum?
misconceptions.repair: Hum along with a flute, then try with a drum.

misconceptions.ask: Is a bird singing a melodic sound?
A door bangs loudly. Is it melodic?
misconceptions.repair: Hum softly, then bang a desk; which has a tune?
Try to clap a tune: can you make it go up and down?

checks.question: Is a flute melodic or non-melodic?
Is a door banging melodic or non-melodic?

skills.key_step: The child hears two short parts of a melody and says like (same tune) or unlike (different tune).

board.do: Sing two parts with the same tune.

misconceptions.ask: Two parts have the same tune and different words. Like or unlike?
misconceptions.repair: Hum both parts with no words.

misconceptions.ask: Two tunes start the same but end differently. Are they like?
misconceptions.repair: Listen to the end of each tune.

misconceptions.ask: The same tune is sung loudly. Is it like or unlike?
misconceptions.repair: Sing the tune soft and loud; are the notes the same?

misconceptions.ask: A boy and a girl sing the same tune. Like or unlike?
misconceptions.repair: Two children sing the same line; hum it together.

checks.question: Same tune, new words: like or unlike?
Do you listen to the words or the tune?

skills.key_step: The child says to echo is to listen first, then sing back the same tune at the same speed and loudness.

floor.prerequisite: Hears when two tunes are the same.
floor.question: Are these the same tune?

listen_for: at the same time as the leader
misconceptions.ask: When do you sing in an echo?
misconceptions.repair: Hold up a hand while the leader sings; drop it to echo.

misconceptions.ask: In an echo, what tune do you sing?
misconceptions.repair: Listen, hum it in your head, then sing.

misconceptions.ask: The leader sings softly. How do you echo?
misconceptions.repair: Play an echo game in a quiet voice.

misconceptions.ask: Should an echo be faster than the leader?
misconceptions.repair: Echo while the teacher taps the speed.

checks.question: When do you sing in an echo?
Do you sing a new tune or the same tune?
